criteria.description: SM4450 hardware-specific architecture characterization: 2x A78 (4-wide OoO) + 6x A55 (2-wide In-order), LPDDR5 25.6 GB/s ceiling documented
stream_pipeline.rs: 3-stage streaming prefetch pipeline implemented with triple buffering and prfm pldl1strm
NEON vectorization: neon_popcount_256 implemented using vld1q_u8 + vcntq_u8 + vaddvq_u8
Branchless boundary counting: count_bytes_before implemented with 16-byte chunked vector accumulation
Bit-exact stream_pipeline test verified 100% green against baseline
ftd_compressed.rs: 16-bit packed FactorTableD entry implemented (lpf_idx: 14, sign: 1, nz: 1), cutting footprint from 40 MB to 20 MB
CompressedFtd 2 MB streaming: stream_d_term implemented with continuous L2-chunk software prefetching
Bit-exact compressed FTD test verified 100% green against standard flat table
phase38_stream.rs silicon probe executed: 64 MB streaming prefetch measured at 7.13 - 7.95 GB/s (8.31 - 9.42 ms)
Law 0.5 compliance: all bandwidth and latency figures measured directly on SM4450 silicon
Unit tests: 57/57 workspace unit test suites across all 5 crates 100% green
Project scoreboard unified across all 38 phases
